title: How to measure AI developer productivity in 2025 | Nicole Forsgren
summary: Nicole Forsgren on measuring developer experience and AI productivity: lines of code is gameable, use SPACE-style multidimensional metrics, surveys and end-to-end velocity, and remember strategy decides what is worth shipping.

verdicts.note: Grounding models in accurate documentation generally improves output, though studies of repository context files show mixed effects on agent success.

METR developers say AI lacks undocumented tacit knowledge of the repo (edge cases, backwards compatibility), which makes its outputs less useful. That fits the claim's mechanism, but documentation was not varied or tested.

MLR synthesis says that giving context (requirements, examples, existing code, API documentation, conventions) reduces ambiguity and improves the relevance of generated artifacts. This concerns context supplied in prompts, not documentation quality inside the codebase, and it is untested.
